description: OpenAgents on your phone: ask anything and get an answer in seconds, start coding tasks that run in our cloud, and connect your own computer when you want to. No computer is needed.
whatToTest:
Welcome to the OpenAgents beta. You don't need a computer.

1. The app opens on a chat. Type a question and send it. The answer streams in, with no sign-in for your first few messages.
2. When it asks you to sign in, use the sign-in sheet. Your chats come with you.
3. Signed in, start a new chat, or ask for a coding task. It runs in our cloud, with free cloud time to try it.
4. After a good answer, the "Run this on your own computer" card shows the command and the download link.

Something wrong? Take a screenshot and send it as TestFlight feedback.

review.notes:
No account, demo login, or computer is needed to review the app.

1. On first launch the app opens on a chat. Type a question such as "What is OpenAgents?" and send it. The answer comes from our hosted assistant and streams in, with no sign-in.
2. After a few messages the app asks you to sign in. The chats you already had move into your account.
3. Signed in, new chats run on our servers. A coding request starts a cloud computer for it, covered by a free allowance.
4. Connecting your own computer is optional: the "Run this on your own computer" card links to https://openagents.com/download. Nothing else in the app needs a computer.

Contact: chris@openagents.com
